concepts.why: Correctly chooses the primitive real-number type double for a holder of values from a double array, but states no rule about double and applies none.

concepts.quote: double min = 0; then loop and keep the smaller value.
concepts.why: Starts the running minimum at 0 ('from nothing'), the folk rule the graph lists as L0; the holder must start at a value no datum can beat (Double.POSITIVE_INFINITY or data[0]), and the 0 start only yields the right answer here by coincidence because every reading is negative, failing silently on any all-positive data.
The answer says nothing about primitive types beyond writing the keyword double.
